caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate sofa positioned frontally on a light-colored background that suggests a wooden floor and neutral wall. The sofa features an elaborately carved wooden frame, colored in shades of reddish-brown, with decorative scrollwork on the arms and backrest. The seating and the inner surfaces of the back and arms are upholstered in a dark blue or nearly black fabric, contrasting with the visible wooden elements. The backrest has a slight arch and the arms are rolled outward, each with scrolled detailing. The base of the sofa displays carved wooden elements, and the piece stands on four short, cabriole legs, each terminating in a small wheel or caster. There are no additional objects or elements visible in the composition.
title: Sofa
